title: Authorization
description: Immutable trust artifact proving that an Authority granted approval for an intended execution.

authorityId.description: Authority issuing this Authorization. Must match authority.authorityId. Parmana rejects a mismatch with a 400.

purpose.description: Business purpose for which the Authorization was granted.

issuedAt.description: UTC timestamp when the Authorization was issued.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp. After this time the Authorization is no longer valid.
